sentence_2_it: Dopo che l'aveva visto, è caduto in una enorme confusione dei pensieri, era divenuto immobile e, in breve, trasformato in pietra.
sentence_2_en: After having caught sight of her, he fell into a huge confusion of thoughts, was motionless and, in short, turned to stone.
sentence_3_it: Lui era immobile come una statua.
sentence_3_en: He was as still as a statue.
